what: IORN-006 organ-specific weighted CTDIvol index for the IORN-007 absorbed-dose eligible cohort (N=32), taken from the published v0.1.1 object (10.5281/zenodo.21817307). Series that 006 left without CTDIvol are filled by ctdose-core v0.1.1 reconstruction where that resolver accepts the scanner.
not: Not absorbed dose. Not a third-party coefficient table. Not a re-segmentation. w_o is copied from the 006 release; CTDIvol is either that release's recorded/reconstructed value or an IORN-004 reconstruction recorded beside it.

iorn006.endpoint: organ-specific weighted CTDIvol index (not absorbed dose)
iorn006.formula: CTDIvol_o = CTDIvol * w_o;  w_o = mean_{z in organ} I(z) / mean_z I(z)
iorn006.note: Read from the published v0.1.1 object, not from the sister working tree. A reviewer who fetches Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21817307 and runs this tool against that checkout gets the same 006 bytes. Imaging is not copied. Values needed for the 007 scatter (w_o and, where 006 defined it, CTDIvol_o) are copied; the rest of the sister results file is not.

iorn004.note: Reconstruction uses 004's published APIs (load_series, collect_recorded_dose, scanners.resolve_model, estimate_ctdivol_open). The cited version is v0.1.1 / 10.5281/zenodo.21636719. metrics / scanners / ctdi_table / pipeline are unchanged since that tag; io.py on HEAD only tightens pixel-padding and is not used for pixels here.

recipe.004_reconstruct: ctdose_core.io.load_series + collect_recorded_dose; if no recorded CTDIvol, ctdi_table.resolve_model then scanners.resolve_model (min score 0.45); estimate_ctdivol_open(..., phantom_cm=32); CTDIvol_o = CTDIvol * w_o with 006's w_o

summary.arithmetic: 23 recorded + 4 already reconstructed in IORN-006 v0.1.1 = 27 with a defined index before this fill; + 3 reconstructed here via IORN-004 = 30; 2 remain unrecoverable. Normalisation to a recorded CTDIvol applies to the recorded series only.

scatter.y: absorbed organ dose (IORN-007, mGy) — GATED, not in this file

reconstructed.label: reconstructed CTDIvol (exact or high-confidence table match)

reconstructed_low_confidence.label: reconstructed CTDIvol, low-confidence scanner match (IORN-004 warning; Revolution CT → Revolution CT ES, score 0.50)

scatter.caption_line: Open squares: CTDIvol reconstructed under IORN-004's own low-confidence warning (Revolution CT matched to Revolution CT ES, score 0.50). Filled squares: reconstructed with an exact or high-confidence table match. Filled circles: recorded in DICOM/RDSR. Two series omitted (LightSpeed Ultra, Revolution EVO).
scatter.fallback_when_ctdivol_unavailable: relative_weight w_o is present on every organ; the mGy-vs-mGy scatter uses only series with a defined CTDIvol_o. A scanner 004's resolver refuses is unrecoverable, not aliased.
